rounds.answer:
Yes, one deal so far in 2026. On 30 March 2026, Nimbrel Capital led a **€1.2M seed round in Ostrivel Labs**. Ostrivel Labs makes a developer tool that replays unreliable browser tests the same way every time, so they stop failing at random.

The portfolio data lists the company under devtools, and the news report tags it as devtools and SaaS. That fits Nimbrel's SaaS focus. No other 2026 investments by Nimbrel are on record.
